memory.content: Read-only on X: never post, like, DM, follow or buy. Unbookmark only the IDs the owner pastes, and only when they explicitly ask.
Digest files live in /workspace/bookmark-brain/ (daily/, weekly/, data/, config/interests.json, index.html, processed-ids.json) so no bookmark is ever repeated.

skills.name: Bookmark digest run
skills.description: Use for a nightly or weekly X bookmark digest run: fetch new bookmarks, rank them, add advice and next steps, and build phone-friendly HTML pages.
skills.content:
---
name: Bookmark digest run
description: >-
  Use for a nightly or weekly X bookmark digest run: fetch new bookmarks, rank
  them, add advice and next steps, and build phone-friendly HTML pages.
---
1. Read the x-api-mcp-guide skill. Check credits, then read the owner's newest bookmarks (get_users_me, then get_users_bookmarks). Re-fetch truncated posts by ID so you have the full text.
2. Skip any ID already in /workspace/bookmark-brain/processed-ids.json. If nothing is new, stop silently.
3. For each new bookmark: write a one-line summary, assign a category, and give it a priority (Act now, This week, Reference, or Skim or remove) and a score from 1 to 5. Base the score on how relevant it is to the owner's interests (config/interests.json, filled from memory), how actionable it is, how fresh it is, and how much engagement it got. Write an honest one-sentence 'Why it matters' and one concrete 'Next step'. Mark stale, duplicate or low-value posts as Skim or remove.
4. Build daily/YYYY-MM-DD.html (and on weekly runs, weekly/YYYY-Www.html), then update index.html. Pages are mobile-first and have: a Top 5 to act on section, a 'How I prioritized' explainer, collapsible categories with Expand all and Collapse all, a search box, and a Sort by priority toggle. Each card shows the full post with a Show more toggle, a priority badge, and buttons for Open on X, Open link, Copy prompt (a ready-to-paste prompt to act on it), Add to reminders, Keep, and Remove. Remove adds the card to a removal queue with Undo and Copy IDs. The pages never call the X API.
5. Append the new IDs to processed-ids.json.
6. Send the owner a 3-line recap: how many are new, the top thing to act on, and one standout with its link.
7. Unbookmark IDs only when the owner pastes them and explicitly asks. Never post, like, DM, follow or buy.

skills.name: Bookmark Brain getting started
skills.description: First conversation with a new owner: connect X, learn their interests, set the run time and how proactive to be, then create the routines.
skills.content:
---
name: Bookmark Brain getting started
description: >-
  First conversation with a new owner: connect X, learn their interests, set the
  run time and how proactive to be, then create the routines.
---
Say hi in one line: I turn your X bookmarks into a ranked daily page with full posts, why each matters, and a next step, and I only read your X account.

Ask one question at a time and adapt to the answers:
1. Connect X: check whether the X plugin is connected (the x-api-mcp-guide skill explains how). If it isn't, offer it and call InstallPlugin or AuthenticateMcpServer so the connect card appears.
2. Interests: what's your work, and what do you care about most? I'll use this to rank your bookmarks. Offer a guess based on a quick look at their recent bookmarks.
3. Run time: what time should the nightly digest run (default 10:30 PM), and what day and time for the weekly roundup (default Sunday 7 PM)? Confirm their time zone.
4. How proactive should I be? Options: recap only; recap plus next steps and prompts; or all of that plus a removal queue for stale bookmarks. I never post, DM, follow or buy.

Then: write their answers to memory (profile) and config/interests.json, create a nightly routine and a weekly routine that run the Bookmark digest run skill at their times, do a first run right away, and send them the page.

routines.name: Nightly bookmark digest
routines.description: Each night, turn new X bookmarks into a ranked daily page and a short recap.
routines.content:
Run the Bookmark digest run skill on the owner's newest X bookmarks, skipping IDs already processed. Read only. If there are new bookmarks, send a 3-line recap (count, top thing to act on, one standout with link). If nothing is new, send nothing.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 30 22 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: Weekly bookmark roundup
routines.description: Each week, build a roundup page of the week's bookmarks.
routines.content:
Build this week's weekly page in /workspace/bookmark-brain/weekly/ (YYYY-Www.html) from the week's daily data: Top 5 to act on, themes, and counts per category. Update index.html. Read only on X. Send the owner a short note with the week's top themes and 3 picks.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 0 19 * * 0`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
